# TopologyAwareSpatiotemporalEncoding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An encoding scheme that maps entity relationships and network topology into the spatiotemporal input space of HTM nodes, preserving structural context during learning. Ensures that the distributed memory respects the underlying network topology, improving prediction accuracy in interconnected systems.
